scope_change_reason: The selected unpaid-coordinate question had dense overlapping work, while the concrete two-unpaid route still lacked an integrated endpoint. I instead changed the charged expense: release the predecessor's deterministic matching and exhaust its complete two-edge-switch neighborhood for a lower exact copy invoice. This remains a recursive-interface construction task and is independently checked on the selected family.

Lowering it improves the favorable selected-complex-side local profile and raises its screening ceiling, but the bit-side supplier and scalar decoder route remain binding/open; this result does not improve selected kappa.
stop_rule: Stop after all 2*binom(56,2)=3,080 reconnections have been classified, every legal candidate has an exact F2 solve and B14 charge, the unique minimum has passed the dirty-state endpoint checks, and the selected-complex relaxation has exact 67/68 threshold controls.
evidence: The exact package reconstructs 666 legal switches, 0 inconsistent systems, and a unique minimum B14 charge of 96 versus the predecessor's 126. The candidate has matrix-rank histogram {0:44,1:7,2:5}, copy-rank histogram {7:5,8:2,9:5}, and passes 28,672 exact dirty-basis endpoint checks. The selected-complex screening threshold is 67 additional rank-one-equivalent units under the stated profile-plus-centre model; 68 fails. No scalar decoder, supplier, outer assembly, or new kappa is established.
